text: Practise together: choose a widespread news item, verify the original source, consult experts — distinguishing (between truth and falsehood) is a life skill.

review_defects.english: distinguishing (between truth and falsehood) is a life skill
review_defects.why: The English adds '(between truth and falsehood)' which is not present in the Arabic. The Arabic only says 'distinguishing' without specifying what is being distinguished.
